title: Supply Chain Ledger
tagline: Supply Chain Ledger is your comprehensive solution for managing and tracking your supply chain using blockchain technology.
description:
Supply Chain Ledger is your comprehensive solution for managing and tracking your supply chain using blockchain technology.

Our platform allows you to securely record and monitor transactions, trace product movement, and collaborate with stakeholders across the supply chain. Build on Ethereum chain, using Web3.js and React
how_its_made: Build on Ethereum chain, using Web3.js and React. Previously, I worked on a couple of web3 projects, but this was bigger than that. I enjoyed working on this project. I explored some partner technologies but didn't use them in the project. I intended to save the image in IPFS, which I will work on.
